set.text: Layout/scope check of P07: the one continuous transverse note overlaps the frame of neighbouring main text. Inverse rotation maps the apparent blob after forment to the current formula number (6), about original (245,1062), and the alleged T_epsilon after voisinages to the main-text underlined NB, about (269,1351). Those elements are transcribed once in the main text, not duplicated as marginal cancellations. The genuine un at about (31,1973) belongs to the margin, as does the separate plus/plein : T fragment near (52–115,1900–1740), whose attachment remains uncertain. Root audit confirmed this source attribution directly in the native page; the tempting rotated cancellation is still excluded. The separate question mark after compact is marginal and has been restored.

Root targeted qualification of the marginal revision fermés to ouverts: with T_epsilon interpreted as the scaled closed subsets defined in the main text, they are not generally open. In the cone on a point, T=[0,1], Y={0}, dotted T={1}, and T_epsilon=[0,epsilon]; for 0<epsilon<1 this is closed and a neighbourhood of Y but not open in T. The circled T_epsilon=[0,epsilon[ are open. The marginal word ouverts, now with an uncertain d’ prefix, is nevertheless retained because its letters and insertion state are visible; the unclear extra fragment plus/plein : T might bear on the intended attachment, which is not imposed here.
